( 02.1 ) — Services

3D Scanning

Capture any part, product or space as an accurate digital model.

We scan parts of every size with a range of professional 3D scanners — from small precision components to car bodies and full buildings. The result is a precise digital copy of the physical object, ready for product design, reverse engineering and quality control.

  • High-accuracy captureBlue-laser and structured-light scanners record detail down to hundredths of a millimetre.
  • Any size, on site or in-houseFrom jewellery to vehicles and plant rooms — we bring the scanner to you when the part can't travel.
  • Clean, usable dataScans are aligned, cleaned and merged into watertight meshes, not raw point dumps.
  • Ready for the next stepData is prepared for reverse engineering, inspection, printing or visualisation.

Deliverables

Point cloud (.PLY, .TXT)Mesh (.STL, .OBJ)Colour/texture scansScan report

( 02.2 ) — Services

Reverse Engineering

Turn scan data into fully editable, manufacturable CAD.

We rebuild physical parts as parametric CAD models — for re-manufacturing legacy parts with no drawings, modifying existing designs, or creating moulds and tooling. You choose how faithful the model should be to the scanned part.

  • Design-intent modellingA clean CAD model with manufacturing imperfections removed — ideal for re-manufacture from 3D models or 2D drawings.
  • NURBS surface modelsPrecise freeform surfaces fitted over scan data where an exact as-is representation matters.
  • Hybrid modellingPrismatic features modelled to design intent, freeform areas surfaced to the scan — the best of both.
  • Drawings on request2D manufacturing drawings with GD&T generated from the final model.

Deliverables

Parametric CAD (.STEP, .IGES, .X_T)Native SolidWorks / Creo / NX2D drawings (.PDF, .DWG)Deviation report vs. scan

( 02.3 ) — Services

Scan to BIM

Existing buildings captured as accurate, intelligent BIM models.

We laser-scan existing structures and convert the point cloud into detailed BIM models. Architects, engineers and contractors get an accurate as-built foundation for renovation, retrofit and facility-management projects — with every wall, slab, column and service documented.

  • As-built accuracyTerrestrial laser scanning records the true geometry of the building, not the original drawings.
  • LOD 200–400 modelsWalls, floors, structure and MEP modelled to the level of detail your project needs.
  • Clash-ready coordinationModels are set up for coordination with new design work in Revit and Navisworks.
  • Drawings from the modelFloor plans, sections and elevations exported straight from the BIM.

Deliverables

Registered point cloud (.E57, .RCP)Revit model (.RVT)IFC export2D plans, sections, elevations

( 02.4 ) — Services

Class A Surfacing

Flawless, curvature-continuous surfaces for visible parts.

Class A surfaces are the visible skins of a product — car body panels, aircraft fairings, consumer-product housings. We build G2/G3-continuous surfaces with clean patch layouts and verify them with zebra and curvature analysis, so reflections flow without a ripple.

  • G2 / G3 continuityCurvature-continuous transitions between every patch for perfect reflections.
  • Analysis-verifiedZebra stripes, highlight lines and curvature combs checked on every surface.
  • From scan or sketchStart from a clay-model scan, a reference surface or concept sketches.
  • Tooling-readySurfaces handed over with draft, flanges and offsets ready for engineering.

Deliverables

Class A surfaces (.IGES, .STEP)Native Alias / ICEM modelsSurface-analysis reportsRender-ready model

( 02.5 ) — Services

Digital Metrology

Compare manufactured parts to their CAD — to the micron.

We inspect manufactured parts by scanning them and comparing the result against the nominal CAD. Colour deviation maps, GD&T checks and first-article reports show exactly where a part is in or out of tolerance — fast, and without contact.

  • Colour deviation mapsFull-surface comparison against CAD, instantly showing where material is over or under.
  • GD&T inspectionFlatness, position, profile and more, measured and reported against the drawing.
  • First-article inspectionComplete FAI reports for new parts, tools and suppliers.
  • Trend analysisRepeated inspections track tool wear and process drift over time.

Deliverables

Inspection report (.PDF)Colour deviation mapsGD&T results tablesScan data for records

( 02.6 ) — Services

3D Printing

Rapid prototypes and functional parts, straight from your model.

We print prototypes, fit-check models, jigs, fixtures and short-run end-use parts directly from CAD or scan data. Our team also prepares and repairs files — including sculpted character models — so they print right the first time.

  • Rapid prototypingPhysical parts in days to check form, fit and function before tooling.
  • Functional materialsEngineering plastics and resins chosen for strength, heat or detail.
  • Print-ready preparationMesh repair, hollowing, supports and orientation handled for you.
  • Character & figure modelsDigitally sculpted busts and figures prepared for high-detail resin printing.

Deliverables

Printed partsPrint-ready files (.STL, .3MF)Finishing / painting on requestSmall production batches
